{{Quote|We're being swindled. Who sells a ship with only enough fuel to reach this lousy rock?|[[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]]|<ref name="Friends and Enemies">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>}}
'''Orondia''' was a bleak [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A [[Orondia station|fueling depot]] was located on the planet's surface. The depot was run by a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Unidentified Bith (Orondia station)|scammer]], in league with his [[Unidentified Bith starship dealer|brother]] on Nal Hutta.
